metrics.title: Net interest margin (%)
metrics.note: Net interest income ×4 / avg earning assets

metrics.title: Efficiency ratio (%)
metrics.note: Noninterest expense / (net interest income + noninterest income)

metrics.title: Provision expense / avg loans (annualized, %)
metrics.note: Provision for credit losses ×4 / avg total loans

metrics.title: Noncurrent loans / total loans (%)
metrics.note: 90+ days past due + nonaccrual / total loans (quarter-end)

metrics.title: Loan loss reserves / total loans (%)
metrics.note: Allowance for loan & lease losses / total loans (quarter-end)

metrics.title: Cost of total deposits (annualized, %)
metrics.note: Deposit interest expense ×4 / avg total deposits (incl. noninterest-bearing)

metrics.title: Cost of interest-bearing deposits (annualized, %)
metrics.note: Deposit interest expense ×4 / avg interest-bearing deposits

metrics.title: Deposit growth YoY (%)

metrics.title: Total asset growth YoY (%)
metrics.note: Industry only. Total assets vs 4 quarters earlier

metrics.title: Loan growth YoY (%)
metrics.note: Industry only. Total loans & leases vs 4 quarters earlier

metrics.title: Tier 1 leverage ratio (%)
metrics.note: Tier 1 capital / average assets for leverage purposes (summed)
